caseNameFull: Latos v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue

C. A. 11th Cir. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pau-­peris denied. Petitioners are allowed until December 19, 2011, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
